exposure.needed: whether any custom setup (selectors, network policies, external tooling) relies on the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label on Strimzi pods or external listener Services

consequence.statement: After the upgrade, Strimzi pods and external listener Services no longer have the `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` label, so custom setups that use it must switch to the `strimzi.io/pod-name` label.
consequence.remediation: Change any custom setup that uses the `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` label to use `strimzi.io/pod-name` instead.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removes the `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` label from pods and external listener Services; custom setups that use this label must switch to `strimzi.io/pod-name`.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The subject is a Kubernetes label (`statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name`) that the operator puts on pods and external listener Services, and none of the subject families covers resource labels.
